messages:
Priya: Quick async check-in — short roundup for roadmap items and launch prep. What I did / blockers / asks.
Priya: Did: finalized embed-cache launch checklist, drafted rollout playbook, created tracking ticket for canary metrics.
Priya: Blocker: staging QA is flaky (timeouts + evictions) causing false negatives for canary validation.
Priya: Today: unblock QA, get Alex to review routing + quantization PRs, confirm canary window with infra, and lock down comms.
Jordan: Done: routing-fallback spec ready — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2745 — includes regional-fallback rules and model-variant mapping. PTAL @Alex
Jordan: Note: added a migration step for model tags so runtime can pick compatible variants automatically.
Devon: QA: repro for timeout flake — minimal repro:
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STAGING' -d '{"prompt":"x","max_tokens":1}'
# sometimes hangs ~12s then 500
```
Devon: Also seeing KV-cache evictions on p3-small when seq_len > 1024, eviction spikes at ~t=7m under load.
Alex: On it — will review PRs later today. For canary suggests: tweak the policy to be conservative:
```json
{"canary_percent":5,"success_rate_threshold":0.98,"rollback_on_error":true}
```
Alex: I can bump staging request timeout from 10s -> 20s for embed-cache tests but want infra signoff. @infra-bot
infra-bot: Applied change: staging request timeout increased to 20s for p3-small pool (change id: cnf-8842). No downtime expected.
Nadia: QA will re-run embed-cache smoke after timeout bump. Checklist: https://docs.redwood.ai/checklists/embed-cache-smoke
Nadia: Plan: smoke + 50 queries, perf baseline, error log capture, report results by EOD.
Sam: Prioritization question: do we ship quantization before GA or post-GA as an opt-in? Tradeoffs: cost wins vs risk of regression.
Priya: Recommendation: ship GA without quantization to reduce risk surface. Post-GA, iterate with a small population test for quantization. Owner for that follow-up: @Jordan.
Jordan: Ack — I'll draft quantization rollout notes and a small A/B plan.
Alex: CR ping: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2752 (quantization hooks). Small test failures, will update tests today.
Priya: Asks: @Alex review routing PR + quant PR; @Nadia run QA after infra bump; @Devon monitor logs during canary; @Sam finalize stakeholder comms.
Priya: If all green, canary scheduled per deploy-bot at 16:30 PT today.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled (id: canary-662) — 5% traffic for 30m, health checks every 1m; will auto-rollback on 2 consecutive health failures.
Devon: Running initial smoke now. Will post results in this thread. :thumbsup:
Alex: LGTM on routing spec; merging after CI fixes.
Sam: I'll draft partner/customer note and share in #marketing after we get canary green.
Priya: Thanks all — will post a quick morning status update tomorrow. Coffee for everyone who helps unblock QA. :coffee:
